schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana (Jeevika Didi Rs 10,000)
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Bihar, through JEEViKA (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society); Urban Development & Housing Department in towns
schemes.brief: Bihar gives one woman in every family Rs 10,000 to start work of her own choice, such as a small shop, tailoring, a beauty parlour, an e-rickshaw, or goat, poultry or cow rearing. She must be a member of a JEEViKA self-help group, or join one; in villages the form is handed in at the JEEViKA village organisation (Gram Sangathan), which approves it and sends it up for payment. Once the work has started it is reviewed, and further help of up to Rs 2 lakh is given in stages. The second instalment of Rs 20,000 is being paid in 2026 to women whose first Rs 10,000 was checked and found properly used.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 first instalment, then up to Rs 2 lakh more after review
eligibility: One woman per family. A family means husband, wife and their unmarried children; an unmarried adult woman whose parents have both died counts as a family of her own
Aged 18 to 60 years and living in Bihar
A member of a JEEViKA self-help group. A woman outside a group can join one by giving a self-declaration at the Gram Sangathan along with her application
Neither the woman nor her husband pays income tax
Neither the woman nor her husband is in government service, whether regular or contract
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman
Bank passbook of a working savings account in her own name, linked to her Aadhaar
Mobile number
Name of her JEEViKA self-help group and Gram Sangathan
Passport-size photograph
Self-declaration form (Annexure-2), only if she is not yet in a self-help group
schemes.submitAt: In a village: at the meeting or office of your JEEViKA Mahila Gram Sangathan (village organisation). Ask your self-help group's Community Mobiliser (CM) or the Gram Sangathan president for the free application form (Annexure-1), fill it in, tick the business you want to start, sign it and hand it in there with photocopies of your Aadhaar and bank passbook. If you are not in a group yet, give the self-declaration form (Annexure-2) at the same place so that you are added to one. In a town: apply on JEEViKA's urban Mahila Rojgar Yojana portal (mmry.brlps.in, linked from brlps.in) when it is open, or ask the urban self-help group office of your municipality. No fee is charged anywhere, and no agent is needed.

demoSteps: Meet your self-help group's Community Mobiliser or the Gram Sangathan president and take the free application form. If you are not in a JEEViKA group, fill the self-declaration form too so that you are added to one.
Fill in your name, family, group, bank account and Aadhaar details, tick the business you want to start, sign, and hand the form in at the Gram Sangathan with copies of your Aadhaar and passbook.
The Gram Sangathan holds a special meeting, approves the eligible applications and sends them to the JEEViKA block office, which enters each one on its MIS portal with the Aadhaar number.
The JEEViKA district office checks the list and JEEViKA headquarters sends Rs 10,000 by DBT to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Check your passbook or ask at the bank or CSC.
Start the work you chose and keep the bills for what you buy. JEEViKA staff come to see how it is going and arrange training.
After the review, women whose work is running get the next instalment (Rs 20,000 in 2026) and later more help, up to Rs 2 lakh in all, in stages.

schemes.title: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana (Bihar DBT Kisan Registration)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Agriculture)
schemes.brief: When floods, heavy rain, drought or hail destroy more than a third of a crop, Bihar pays farmers in the notified panchayats an input subsidy for each hectare lost, straight into the bank. To get this, or any other farm subsidy such as diesel, seed or machines, a farmer first registers once on the DBT Agriculture portal and gets a 13-digit registration number. The latest round, for crops lost in the floods of August and September 2026, took applications in October 2026; a new round opens after each notified disaster, usually for about a week.
schemes.benefit: Rs 8,500 a hectare (rain-fed), Rs 17,000 (irrigated), Rs 22,500 (perennial crops), up to 2 hectares
eligibility: Your land is in a panchayat notified as affected for that round; the list of panchayats is published on the portal
More than 33 per cent of the crop was lost because of the notified flood, heavy rain, drought or hail
Registered on the DBT Agriculture portal, with a bank account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Landowners, tenant or sharecropping farmers (vastavik khetihar), or both may apply, but only one person is paid for one field
One application per family (husband, wife and minor children), paid for at most 2 hectares (494 decimal); the least paid is Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000 or Rs 2,500 depending on the land type
A farmer found burning straw (parali) in the field is refused
documents: Aadhaar card, checked by OTP, fingerprint or iris during registration
Bank passbook of an account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Mobile number registered on the portal, for the OTP
For landowners: rent receipt (lagan rasid) of 2023-24, 2024-25 or 2025-26, or a recent LPC; a family tree (vanshavali) is not accepted
For tenant farmers: the self-declaration form certified jointly by the ward member, mukhiya or sarpanch and the Krishi Samanvayak
Thana, khata and khesra numbers of the damaged field and the names of two neighbouring farmers
schemes.portalName: DBT Agriculture portal, Agriculture Department, Bihar

demoFields.hint: Where your land is. Only farmers of the notified panchayats can claim the input subsidy.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An Aadhaar-linked account. The portal warns that a wrong account number blocks your registration, so copy it from the passbook.

demoFields.label: Registration number (13 digits)
demoFields.hint: The number you got after registering. Enter it on the Krishi Input Anudan form and your details appear by themselves.

demoFields.label: Farmer type (Kisan ka prakar)
demoFields.hint: Own land, land taken on rent or share, or both. You can apply under only one type.

demoFields.hint: Copy them from your rent receipt or LPC.

demoFields.hint: 1 acre is 100 decimal and 1 hectare is 247 decimal. The subsidy is paid for at most 494 decimal.

demoSteps: Register once: open dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in, click Kisan Panjikaran, verify your Aadhaar, fill in your farmer, land and bank details and note the 13-digit registration number. The block agriculture office (e-Kisan Bhawan) does it free; a CSC or Vasudha Kendra can also do it.
After a flood or drought, check the panchayat list on the portal. If your panchayat is listed, open Krishi Input Anudan under online services within the dates shown, usually about a week.

Enter the 13-digit number, choose your farmer type, fill in the total and damaged land in decimal, the thana-khata-khesra numbers and two neighbours' names, enter the captcha and the OTP, upload the rent receipt, LPC or certified self-declaration, and submit. The application number comes by SMS.

The Krishi Samanvayak visits the field within 2 to 4 days, photographs the plot and forwards or rejects the claim with a reason. The sub-divisional and district agriculture officers and the district disaster officer then approve it.
The approved amount is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT and an SMS tells you. Use Print and Status on the portal with your registration number to follow it.
schemes.helpline: DBT / PM-Kisan call centre, Agriculture Department Bihar: 0612-2233555 (10:30 am to 5 pm, working days); Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551

schemes.title: Diesel Anudan Yojana (Bihar Diesel Subsidy for Irrigation)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Agriculture)
schemes.brief: When the monsoon fails and farmers have to water kharif crops with diesel pump sets, Bihar pays back part of the diesel cost: Rs 75 a litre, counted as Rs 750 an acre for each watering. Farmers registered on the DBT Agriculture portal upload the computerised petrol-pump receipt and apply online, and the money goes to their Aadhaar-linked bank account. The 2026-27 kharif round was ordered on 10 August 2026 and covers the districts the state named as short of rain; each year the list of districts is shown on the application page.
schemes.benefit: Rs 750 an acre per watering, up to Rs 2,250 an acre, for up to 8 acres
eligibility: Registered on the DBT Agriculture portal with a 13-digit number, and a bank account linked to Aadhaar and NPCI
Owner farmers, sharecroppers (bataidar), or both, in villages or towns of the covered districts
Paddy nursery and jute: up to 2 waterings (Rs 1,500 an acre). Standing paddy, maize, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables and medicinal plants: up to 3 waterings (Rs 2,250 an acre)
Diesel bought for irrigation from a registered petrol pump in Bihar, between the start date and the last date of the scheme
One applicant per family (husband, wife and minor children), for at most 8 acres; the least paid is Rs 100
documents: 13-digit DBT Agriculture registration number
Computerised or digital receipt from the petrol pump, with the last 10 digits of your registration number written on it and your signature or thumb mark
For owner farmers: rent receipt (lagan rasid) or LPC issued in 2023-24, 2024-25 or 2025-26
For sharecroppers: the prescribed form signed jointly by a ward member, mukhiya, sarpanch or panchayat samiti member and the Krishi Samanvayak
Thana, khata and khesra numbers of the field watered, and the names of two neighbouring farmers
Mobile number registered on the portal, for the OTP

demoFields.hint: Owners upload the rent receipt or LPC; sharecroppers upload the form signed by the ward member or mukhiya and the Krishi Samanvayak.

demoSteps: If you have no 13-digit number yet, register once on dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in under Kisan Panjikaran, free at the block agriculture office or for a small fee at a CSC.

After the scheme opens, buy diesel for irrigation from a registered pump in Bihar. Ask for a computerised receipt, have the last 10 digits of your registration number written on it, and sign it with your full name.

Open the diesel subsidy (kharif) application on the portal or on the Bihar Krishi app, enter the 13-digit number, choose the crop and farmer type, and fill in the field details, the area watered and which watering it is.
Upload the receipt and land papers, enter the captcha and the OTP and submit. Keep the application number from the SMS, and make a fresh application for each watering.
The Krishi Samanvayak checks the claim, and the block and district agriculture officers approve it.
The subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT. Use the Diesel Subsidy Status link on the portal to follow it.
schemes.helpline: DBT / PM-Kisan call centre, Agriculture Department Bihar: 0612-2233555 (10:30 am to 5 pm, working days); Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551

schemes.title: Bihar Building Workers Registration (BOCW Labour Card)
schemes.department: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.brief: Masons, labourers, carpenters, painters, plumbers and other construction workers who register with the Bihar BOCW Welfare Board get a labour card that opens more than a dozen benefits: Rs 50,000 for a daughter's marriage, maternity and paternity money, a bicycle grant, help with children's studies, Rs 3,000 a year for medical costs, a Rs 1,000 monthly pension at 60, and Rs 2 to 4 lakh to the family if the worker dies. Registration is done online with Aadhaar on the board's portal, or at a CSC or the block labour office. The fee is small: Rs 20 for registration plus the membership fee, Rs 50 in all for five years.
schemes.benefit: Marriage help Rs 50,000, pension Rs 1,000 a month, death help Rs 2 to 4 lakh, and more
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years
Worked at least 90 days in building or other construction work in the last 12 months
The 90 days are certified by the employer or contractor, the Labour Enforcement Officer, a registered trade union officer, or your own self-declaration
Not registered with any other labour welfare board
Most benefits need some time as a member: 1 year for maternity, bicycle and study help; 3 years for marriage help and house repair; 5 years for the pension
Keep the membership renewed; benefits stop while it has lapsed
documents: Aadhaar card, checked by OTP
Mobile number
Recent photograph
90-day work certificate or self-declaration, with the employer's or contractor's name and address, the work dates and the kind of work
Ration card number
Bank passbook with account number and IFSC
Names, dates of birth and Aadhaar of family members, for the nominee

demoSteps: Open bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in, click Labour Registration, enter your Aadhaar number and name and authenticate with the OTP. If your mobile is not linked to Aadhaar, a CSC or the block Labour Enforcement Officer can do it with your fingerprint.
Verify your mobile number with OTP and fill in your personal details: area, district, mother's name, marital status, category, education and ration card number.
Add the employers you worked for in the last 12 months (at least 90 days in all), choose the certifying authority and upload the certificate or self-declaration.
Add family members and choose a nominee with a share, upload your photo, pay the fee online, then Preview and Submit. Note the application number.

The Labour Enforcement Officer checks and approves the application, and the registration number comes by SMS. Log in with that number and your year of birth to download the labour card and fee receipt.

To claim a benefit later, log in as Labour, choose the scheme, fill in the details and upload the proof (marriage card, birth certificate, mark sheet and so on). Approved money comes to your bank account. Renew the membership before it runs out.
schemes.helpline: Labour Enforcement Officer (LEO) at your block office, or the Labour Superintendent office in your district

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana Bihar (Ayushman Card for Ration Card Holders)
schemes.department: Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti, Health Department, Government of Bihar, with the National Health Authority
schemes.brief: Bihar pays for the same free hospital cover of Rs 5 lakh a year as Ayushman Bharat for ration-card families that the central PM-JAY list left out. Since 2024 every family holding an NFSA ration card in Bihar is covered, either under PM-JAY or under this state scheme, and both use the same Ayushman card at any empanelled hospital. The card is made free with the ration card and Aadhaar, on the Ayushman app or website, at a CSC, or at camps held at ration shops.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: The family holds a Bihar ration card under the National Food Security Act (priority household or Antyodaya)
Families already on the central PM-JAY list are covered by PM-JAY; the other ration-card families are covered by this state scheme, with the same card
Every member named on the ration card is covered, with no limit on family size or age
Illnesses you already have are covered from the first day
Each member needs his or her own card, made after Aadhaar e-KYC
documents: Ration card (NFSA); the family is searched by the ration card number
Aadhaar card of each member whose card is being made
Mobile number for the OTP
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Mobile number

demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app, log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, and choose the state Bihar.
Search by your ration card number. All members on the card appear; if your family is not found, search by Aadhaar.
Pick the member whose card is pending, complete Aadhaar OTP or face e-KYC, take the live photo, add the relation, district and PIN code, and submit.

Bihar Swasthya Suraksha Samiti approves the request, usually within a day or two. Log in again and download the card. You can also get it made free at a CSC, a government hospital or a camp at your ration shop.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card and Aadhaar. Empanelled hospitals are listed at hospitals.pmjay.gov.in. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.
